name: managing-commercial-loan-underwriting
description: Drafts commercial loan underwriting packages and credit memos for banks and nonbank lenders: financial spreads tied to source statements; cash available for debt service and DSCR after taxes, distributions and unfinanced capex; global cash flow across borrower, guarantors and affiliates; structure, amortization within collateral useful life and maximum loan amount; covenant levels with headroom; collateral and LTV on the lesser of cost or a lender-reviewed appraisal; appraisal and evaluation thresholds (12 CFR 34.43, $500,000 CRE threshold); CRE concentrations; Regulation O insider loans and board approval; Regulation B adverse action notices and spouse guaranty limits; Section 1071 compliance dates and firewall; leveraged lending status; policy tests, exceptions and a draft recommendation. Use for loan underwriting, credit memo, credit analysis, DSCR, global cash flow, risk rating or credit committee package. Declines to adjust spreads to meet policy thresholds. Drafts for credit officer review.
